keyEvents.text: Luís Balbo (Sturm Graz) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Luca Weinhandl (Sturm Graz).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay in match because of an injury Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim).
Substitution, Hoffenheim. Tim Lemperle replaces Wouter Burger because of an injury.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Hoffenheim 0, Sturm Graz 1. Oumar Diakité (Sturm Graz) left footed shot from very close range to the bottom left corner following a corner.
Second Half begins Hoffenheim 0, Sturm Graz 1.
Albert Vallci (Sturm Graz) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Hoffenheim. Patrick Wimmer replaces Adam Daghim.
Substitution, Hoffenheim. Bambasé Conté replaces Mats Rots.
Substitution, Hoffenheim. Andrej Kramaric replaces Fisnik Asllani.
Substitution, Sturm Graz. Simon Seidl replaces Seedy Jatta.
Goal! Hoffenheim 1, Sturm Graz 1. Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal.
Substitution, Sturm Graz. Nelson Weiper replaces Oumar Diakité.
Goal! Hoffenheim 2, Sturm Graz 1. Bambasé Conté (Hoffenheim) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Tim Lemperle.
